content.text:
Here's `src/server-hook.ts` — 925 lines, the hook-facing HTTP server:

**Endpoints:**
- `POST /intent` (line 77) — `UserPromptSubmit`: registers intent, backfills from transcript, builds contextual goal, emits feed entry
- `POST /register` (line 213) — benchmark-compatible session registration
- `POST /evaluate` (line 233) — `PreToolUse`: core judge pipeline; handles locked sessions, calls `interceptor.evaluate`, records hijack strikes, returns allow/deny
- `POST /track` (line 469) — `PostToolUse`: records file reads/writes and env var usage
- `POST /end` (line 517) — `Stop`: logs summary, cleans up session state
- `POST /pivot` / `/compact` (lines 555/572) — direction change and compaction notifications

**Cross-origin API (dashboard → hook):**
- `GET /api/feed` (line 813) — live event ring buffer
- `POST /api/mode` (line 820) — runtime `TrustMode` switch (line 829: `CONFIG.mode = next as TrustMode`)

**Key behaviours:**
- `learn` mode (line 246, 395): shadow evaluation — logs what would have been blocked but passes through
- Hijack strikes (line 369): tracks `hijacked` verdicts; locks session after `CONFIG.hijackThreshold` strikes (autonomous mode only)
- CORS (line 57): `applyCors` gates cross-origin requests to `DREDD_DASHBOARD_ORIGIN`

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Judge AI Dredd — Dashboard</title>
  <link rel="icon" href="/favicon.ico" type="image/x-icon">
  <style>
    :root {
      --bg: #0d1117;
      --card: #161b22;
      --border: #30363d;
      --text: #e6edf3;
      --muted: #8b949e;
      --green: #3fb950;
      --red: #f85149;
      --amber: #d29922;
      --blue: #58a6ff;
      --purple: #bc8cff;
    }
    * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
    body {
      font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
      background: var(--bg);
      color: var(--text);
      padding: 20px;
      max-width: 1400px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }
    header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
      padding-bottom: 16px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    }
    header h1 { font-size: 24px; font-weight: 600; }
    header h1 span { color: var(--red); }
    .version { color: var(--muted); font-size: 14px; }
    .mode-badge {
      padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 12px;
      font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase;
    }
    .mode-interactive { background: var(--amber); color: #000; }
    .mode-autonomous { background: var(--red); color: #fff; }
    .mode-learn { background: var(--blue); color: #fff; }
    .mode-select {
      background: var(--card); color: var(--text);
      border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 12px;
      padding: 4px 10px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600;
      text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; font-family: inherit;
    }
    .mode-select:hover { border-color: var(--muted); }

    .stats {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(180px, 1fr));
      gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 24px;
    }
    .stat {
      background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 8px; padding: 16px;
    }
    .stat-value { font-size: 32px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; }
    .stat-label { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 4px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.5px; }
    .stat-value.green { color: var(--green); }
    .stat-value.red { color: var(--red); }
    .stat-value.amber { color: var(--amber); }
    .stat-value.blue { color: var(--blue); }

    .section-title {
      font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 12px;
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
    }
    .section-title .count {
      background: var(--border); color: var(--muted);
      padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 10px; font-size: 12px;
    }
